status_mirror_policy: Domain status here mirrors processing_order.json; a disagreement blocks transitions and requires Commander review.
wave_rationale: This order schedules knowledge work only. It is not a business dependency, a requirement to sell or validate an offer first, or a claim that writing knowledge generates customers.

source_copy_policy.safe_names: Use a traversal-free stable source id mapped to the original id; never overwrite an existing file, index, or different source. Record collisions and reuse verified identity instead of making duplicate evidence.
source_copy_policy.legacy_source_refs: Index and links only; no raw copies or second canonical source store.

vault_reference_policy.note: canonical_evidence_paths retains its v2 key for structural navigation only. Neither acceptance of old canonical knowledge nor its taxonomy decides new source classification. Raw body, structure and purpose with locators decide.

catalog_change.note: All v2 identifiers are retained. Negotiation is a provisional organizational section explicitly requested by the latest user message, not extracted raw knowledge.

classification_policy.method: Review the source body, its structure, and its principal purpose together. Filenames, isolated keywords, and frequency scores alone are not sufficient.
classification_policy.primary_ownership: One reviewed primary route and one independent byte-exact copy per source. Secondary references point to the same source id and bounded raw evidence, not repeated copies or independent evidence counts.
classification_policy.uncertainty: Ambiguity is uncertain or cross_domain_review, not quarantine. Pending means awaiting knowledge work, not a source defect. Preserve unresolved candidates visibly in the intake ledger.
classification_policy.serial_lock: Global intake may read and route any domain, including pending domains. Only knowledge manufacture is serial; route_done never opens extraction in a pending domain.
classification_policy.secondary_canonical_status: Old Vault references are structural hints only, never classification evidence or a prerequisite for accepting new raw evidence.
classification_policy.archive_policy: The old Vault _archive/ is not an active evidence source.

raw_new_inventory.note: Historical v2 observation: this manifest had no raw/new rows. Not a new inventory or a semantic-read claim. It does not imply the absence of other source records; raw remains immutable.

domains.title: Sales and Closing — المبيعات والإغلاق

subdomains.title: Discovery and sales conversations
subdomains.basis: Retained v2 organizing proposal: discovery, framing, questions, diagnosis, and solution presentation; source classification awaits raw reading.

subdomains.title: Lead qualification
subdomains.basis: Retained v2 organizing proposal: ICP, fit criteria, and pre-call qualification; not an accepted source classification.

subdomains.title: Objection handling
subdomains.basis: Retained v2 proposal; objections are also explicitly mentioned in the latest user expansion request. Raw passages must still establish ownership.

subdomains.title: High-ticket closing
subdomains.basis: Retained v2 organizing proposal: premium positioning, trust, and high-ticket decisions; raw evidence decides inclusion.

subdomains.title: Proposal, follow-up, and pipeline
subdomains.basis: Proposal, follow-up, and pipeline signals are an initial organizing boundary; the source review must confirm the final boundary.

subdomains.title: Negotiation — التفاوض
subdomains.basis: The user explicitly requested a negotiation section; no negotiation knowledge or raw classification is asserted here.

body_signals: Candidate passages discuss diagnosis, fit, negotiation, objections, proposals, closing, or sales follow-up; retain exact locators, not filename-only inference.
These are provisional routing signals, not findings from semantic reading of raw in this task.
structure_signals: A call transcript, question-to-diagnosis flow, objection/response analysis, or proposal-to-decision workflow is a candidate structural signal, not a classification verdict.
Negotiation dialogue, option/trade-off comparisons, and documented decision stages are proposed structural signals.
purpose_signals: The source primarily explains a sales conversation, qualification decision, negotiation, objection, or closing process.
Purpose is inferred from raw evidence with locators; knowledge-wave order is not a business dependency.

secondary_references.precedence: Raw body, structure and purpose decide the route. Vault paths are structural references only; their acceptance status is unrelated to routing.
requirements: Record the exact raw path, source identifier, byte hash, and evidence locator.
Keep direct quotes separate from inference, reported result, example, and unresolved interpretation.
Link the same source identity and its single primary copy; do not count a secondary reference as independent evidence.
Use cross_domain_review only for unresolved ownership, not merely because another domain is pending.
disallowed: Unattributed summaries treated as canonical evidence.
Claims promoted from a secondary reference without a source locator.
Moving, renaming, normalizing, or deleting raw evidence.

quarantine.handling: Record a verified source-integrity defect and reason without editing raw. Ambiguity goes to uncertain/cross_domain_review; pending work is deferred, not quarantined.

cross_domain_review.sequential_lock: Routing review is allowed globally; knowledge extraction still obeys the single-domain lock.
required_when: A source materially covers more than one first-wave domain.
The boundary between sales discovery/qualification and outreach lead sourcing or messaging is unclear.
The boundary between sales price objections and pricing_offers design is unclear.
The boundary between sales language and content_strategy ideation is unclear.
cross_domain_review.decision_rule: Resolve one primary source route from raw evidence, with bounded secondary refs. Unresolved ownership remains uncertain, never quarantined solely for ambiguity.

domains.title: Outreach and lead generation — الوصول وتوليد الفرص

subdomains.title: Lead generation and prospect research
subdomains.basis: Account targeting, list building, data, and prospect research.

subdomains.title: Cold email and message systems
subdomains.basis: Cold email structure, messaging, personalization, calls to action, and sequences.

subdomains.title: Outreach mechanics and follow-up
subdomains.basis: Personalization, value-first outreach, channel mechanics, and follow-up.

subdomains.title: Email deliverability infrastructure
subdomains.basis: SPF/DKIM/DMARC, warm-up, reputation, infrastructure, and list hygiene.

subdomains.title: Outreach measurement and scaling
subdomains.basis: Reply, meeting, close, experiment, and scaling signals.

body_signals: Source passages explain prospect lists, outbound targeting, cold messages, sending infrastructure, deliverability, sequences, or converting a reply into a booked conversation.
These are provisional routing signals, not new raw-reading findings. Pending knowledge status does not block intake classification.
structure_signals: A list-to-message-to-reply-to-meeting workflow, outreach sequence, campaign experiment, or DNS/inbox setup procedure is a candidate structural signal.
Separate sourcing, message systems, follow-up mechanics, infrastructure, and measurement when the raw structure supports that distinction.
purpose_signals: The source primarily explains outbound contact, prospect research, message delivery, or response handling.
This describes source purpose, not a promise that authoring the wiki generates opportunities or a prerequisite to pricing knowledge.

secondary_references.precedence: Raw body, structure and purpose decide routing, even while outreach is pending. Old Vault references are structural hints only.
requirements: Use one source id and primary copy; bounded secondary references are not independent evidence.
Record source path, source identifier, hash, locator, scope, and evidence type.
Keep deliverability claims distinct from response, meeting, and closing claims.
Send offer, pricing, or sales-conversation ownership questions to cross_domain_review.
disallowed: Extracting knowledge in this domain before sales reaches domain_done; global intake routing is allowed.
Treating outreach volume, reply, or meeting counts as sales completion.
Changing raw evidence or importing untraceable benchmarks.

quarantine.handling: Integrity defects only. Pending is deferred knowledge work; ambiguous routing is uncertain/cross_domain_review, not quarantine.

cross_domain_review.sequential_lock: Active for global intake routing now; it does not authorize knowledge extraction in outreach while pending.
required_when: Follow-up after a sales call overlaps with the sales pipeline.
A message or response depends on pricing, offer, or content positioning.
cross_domain_review.decision_rule: Outreach owns the channel and lead-generation mechanism; sales owns discovery, qualification, objections, and closing.

domains.title: Pricing and offer design — التسعير وتصميم العروض

subdomains.title: Offer design and transformation
subdomains.basis: Customer, promise, outcome, and unique mechanism.

subdomains.title: Value ladder and packaging
subdomains.basis: Free, low-, mid-, and high-ticket levels and movement between them.

subdomains.title: Pricing architecture and tiers
subdomains.basis: Pricing models, packages, retainers, performance, and custom pricing.

subdomains.title: Value stack and anchoring
subdomains.basis: Value aggregation, comparison, anchors, and decoys.

subdomains.title: Guarantees, risk reversal, and price objections
subdomains.basis: Guarantees, risk reduction, and price-objection treatment.

body_signals: Source passages explain what is sold, promised transformation, value, packaging, tiers, pricing models, anchoring, guarantees, or risk allocation, rather than only handling a live sales objection.
These provisional signs require raw reading; no completed sales practice, outreach campaign, or accepted old master is a routing prerequisite.
structure_signals: An offer-design workflow, package comparison, value ladder, pricing calculation, or guarantee-conditions analysis is a candidate structural signal.
Offer, value, packaging, tiers, guarantees, and price objections remain provisional boundaries decided from raw evidence.
purpose_signals: The source primarily explains offer composition, value, price architecture, packaging, or guarantee conditions.
Wave scheduling is not a requirement to validate or sell an actual offer before constructing knowledge.

secondary_references.precedence: The raw source determines classification. Vault paths inform possible structure only, regardless of old knowledge acceptance.
requirements: Use one primary source copy and scoped secondary references; shared evidence is counted once.
Record whether a price or result is a recommendation, example, reported result, or measured observation.
State market, audience, currency, time, and denominator whenever the source provides them.
Send objections and conversation ownership questions to cross_domain_review with sales.
disallowed: Extracting knowledge in this domain before outreach reaches domain_done; global intake routing is allowed.
Presenting a provisional price or guarantee as a validated recommendation.
Using uncited market benchmarks or editing raw evidence.

quarantine.handling: Integrity defects only. Deferred knowledge is pending; incomplete routing evidence or conflicting ownership is uncertain/cross_domain_review.

cross_domain_review.sequential_lock: Global routing is allowed now; knowledge extraction waits for the preceding domain_done.
required_when: An objection is a sales conversation issue rather than a package-design issue.
A value proposition depends on outreach response or customer-fit evidence.
An offer message is intended for content distribution rather than a sales asset.
cross_domain_review.decision_rule: Pricing_offers owns offer, packaging, value, and price architecture; sales retains live objection and closing context.

domains.title: Content strategy — استراتيجية المحتوى

subdomains.title: Audience, positioning, and content manifesto
subdomains.basis: Audience, positioning, voice, and explicit content boundaries.

subdomains.title: Content funnel: TOFU, MOFU, BOFU
subdomains.basis: Awareness, nurture, and conversion stages.

subdomains.title: Customer voice and validated ideation
subdomains.basis: Customer questions, objections, outcomes, problems, and tested ideas.

subdomains.title: Content formats and repurposing
subdomains.basis: Content forms, content Lego, batching, and reuse.

subdomains.title: Distribution, calendar, and measurement
subdomains.basis: Platforms, cadence, TVP, and commercial-signal measurement.

subdomains.title: Content monetization and offer alignment
subdomains.basis: Connecting content to lead magnet, email sequence, offer, and revenue path.

body_signals: Source passages explain audience, positioning, content pillars, funnel stages, ideation inputs, distribution cadence, repurposing strategy, or the path from content to an offer.
These are proposed classification signs, not observed raw findings. Intake does not require a validated offer or completed business campaign.
structure_signals: An audience-to-pillar-to-funnel plan, editorial calendar, distribution system, or measurement feedback loop is a candidate structural signal; an editing tutorial alone is not.
Production, hooks, storytelling, and scripts are adjacent clusters and are not silently merged into this strategy domain.
Raw evidence may challenge these provisional boundaries without requiring acceptance of old Vault knowledge.
purpose_signals: The source primarily explains planning, audience, content distribution, or measurement rather than production instructions alone.
The order schedules knowledge work, not business execution or promised customer acquisition.

secondary_references.precedence: Raw body, structure and purpose govern classification; the Vault is a structural guide only. Pending status does not prevent routing.
requirements: Link a single source identity and primary copy; secondary references do not multiply evidence or coverage.
Separate strategy claims from production instructions and platform-specific execution.
Record whether an idea is observed, reported, inferred, or merely proposed.
Send production, hook, storytelling, or copywriting ownership questions to cross_domain_review.
disallowed: Extracting knowledge in this domain before pricing_offers reaches domain_done; global intake routing is allowed.
Treating views or followers as commercial validation without a defined link to the funnel.
Presenting provisional content pillars as accepted strategy or modifying raw evidence.

quarantine.handling: Integrity defects only; out-of-scope or ambiguous routing remains uncertain/cross_domain_review, and deferred knowledge remains pending.

cross_domain_review.sequential_lock: Global intake review is allowed now; only knowledge manufacture waits for pricing_offers domain_done.
required_when: Customer language belongs to sales evidence but is being proposed as content strategy.
An offer or price claim is used as a content conversion claim.
A production, hook, storytelling, platform, or copywriting source is proposed for this strategic cluster.
cross_domain_review.decision_rule: Content_strategy owns the strategic engine and funnel alignment; adjacent production and platform material requires explicit review.
